parts.name: Root
parts.description: The listbox container. Manages option registration, selection state, focus, and keyboard navigation.

props.name: selectionBehavior
props.description: How selection behaves: 'toggle' allows deselection, 'replace' always selects.

props.name: emptyPlaceholder
props.description: Content shown when the list is empty. Can be a string or a Snippet.

props.name: items
props.description: Iterable of items for dynamic rendering. Used with a snippet that receives each item.

props.name: getItemKey
props.description:
Reads an item's key — the same value passed as `ListBox.Item`'s `id`.

Only needed together with `virtualizer`: a Shift range is otherwise measured over
the options in the DOM, which for a virtualized list is just the rendered window,
so the range stops wherever the user happened to have scrolled.

props.name: disabledKeys
props.description: Keys of items that should be disabled and non-selectable.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Selection mode: 'single' allows one selection, 'multiple' allows many.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected keys. Two-way by default — use `bind:value`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial selection, for when `value` is not supplied.

props.name: controlledValue
props.description:
Opt into fully controlled state: the component stops writing back to `value` and
only reports through `onChange`, so the parent can reject a change by not flowing
the new selection back down. Off by default, because `bind:value` — the common
case — needs the write-back to work at all.

props.name: children
props.description: Content of the listbox. Can be static children or a snippet receiving items.

props.name: header
props.description:
Rows rendered inside the listbox above the items — an action row such as
"Create …". Kept out of `children` because in dynamic mode that snippet is called
once per item.

A virtualized list does not navigate into it: navigation there walks the item
array, which this is not part of.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class to apply to the listbox container.

props.name: id
props.description: HTML id attribute for the listbox element.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label for the listbox. Announced by screen readers.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description:
Id of a visible element that labels the listbox. Use instead of `aria-label`
 when the list already has a heading on screen.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback fired when the selection changes.

props.name: disableFocusHandling
props.description: Disable DOM focus handling on the root container for virtual-focus compositions.

props.name: loop
props.description: Whether arrow-key navigation wraps from the last item to the first (and back).

props.name: typeahead
props.description: Whether typing characters moves focus to the option whose text matches.

props.name: virtualizer
props.description:
Renders only the rows near the viewport instead of all of them.

Only honoured together with `items`: the listbox has to own the loop to be able to
slice it, so a list written as static children is never virtualized.

Rows must all be the same height — that assumption is what lets the scrollbar be
sized without measuring every row. The height is measured from the first rendered
row unless `rowHeight` says otherwise, so a themed list needs no magic number.

The listbox element itself is the scroller: give it a max height and
`overflow-y: auto`, as an unvirtualized long list would need anyway.

dataAttributes.name: data-empty-placeholder
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the placeholder option rendered when the list has no items.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus is inside the listbox.

dataAttributes.name: data-listbox-spacer
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the element holding the full scroll height while virtualised.

dataAttributes.name: data-listbox-window
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the element holding the rows currently rendered by the virtualiser.

parts.name: Item
parts.description: A selectable option. Registers itself with the root and exposes selected, focused, hovered, pressed, and disabled states through data attributes.

props.name: id
props.description: Unique identifier for this item. Used for selection tracking.

props.name: textValue
props.description: Text value for typeahead search. If not provided, extracted from content.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether this item is disabled and non-selectable.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class to apply to the item element.

props.name: children
props.description: Content to render inside the item.

props.name: customId
props.description: Override the generated ID. Useful for components with custom ID requirements.

props.name: disableFocusHandling
props.description: Disable real DOM focus handling. When true, no tabindex is set and focus events are skipped.

props.name: isFocusedOverride
props.description: Override the focused state. When provided, this value is used instead of internal focus tracking.

props.name: isFocusVisibleOverride
props.description: Override the focus-visible presentation state.

props.name: onItemSelect
props.description: Override the select behavior. When provided, called instead of default listbox selection.

props.name: onResolvedTextValue
props.description: Callback with resolved text value when mounted (from prop or rendered content).

props.name: onItemHoverStart
props.description: Callback when pointer hover should move logical focus to this item.

props.name: scrollOnFocus
props.description: Whether to scroll this item into view when focused. Useful for virtual focus patterns.

props.name: isParentDisabled
props.description: Additional disabled state from parent.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Override the visual pressed state. When provided, this value is used instead of internal press tracking.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the item is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the item is focused.

dataAttributes.name: data-hovered
dataAttributes.description: Present while the pointer is over the item.

dataAttributes.name: data-item-id
dataAttributes.description: The item id used for selection.

dataAttributes.name: data-item-id-type
dataAttributes.description: Whether the item id is a "string" or a "number".

dataAttributes.name: data-navigation-item
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the item as a keyboard-navigation target.

dataAttributes.name: data-pressed
dataAttributes.description: Present while the item is actively pressed.

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present while the item is selected.
